signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: The vendor may discontinue the product, which ends a lifetime deal.

evidence.quote: If the Company suspends or discontinues the Services, Your sole remedy shall be a refund for any prepaid amount related to any such suspension or discontinuation.

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage. 2 reviews say limits were reduced.

evidence.quote: KingSumo’s intuitive editor makes it easy to set up and launch unlimited viral giveaways in minutes
Run as many giveaways as you want. No limits, ever. Go crazy!

I'll give it 2 tacos for what it used to be but why is it no longer working?

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 5 reviews (7.7% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: Been back and forth with the Scrab.in team and no feedback in months.
The response is very slow, and the issues continue.
I've emailed support asking how I can limit entries to US residents only ... but crickets, no answer.

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 20 reviews average 2.95/5 vs 3.83/5 all-time (-0.88). 23% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The $0 tier lacks 8 of 12 features in the $49 tier.

evidence.quote: KingSumo Free Plan ($0): Unlimited giveaways; Bonus entries; Embed on any website; Select multiple prizes and winners; Basic, including SendFox and Zapier Integrations

signals.label: Vendor age & track record

trials.claim: Set up and launch unlimited viral giveaways in minutes
trials.claimQuote: KingSumo’s intuitive editor makes it easy to set up and launch unlimited viral giveaways in minutes.
trials.reasoning: Users report setup was frustrating for a newcomer and an integration failure cost 2 days of a giveaway, directly conflicting with easy setup and launching in minutes.

exhibits.quote: I am sure this is a great product for more techy people but to much frustration for a new person like myself who has never done an online giveaway.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows setup was frustrating and not fast or easy for a new user.

exhibits.quote: I lost 2 days of the giveaway because my integration didn't work the first time.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows setup failed and cost days, contradicting launch in minutes.

exhibits.quote: Run as many giveaways as you want. No limits, ever. Go crazy!
exhibits.argument: This vendor statement confirms unlimited giveaways are allowed without limits.

exhibits.quote: The setup is simple, the interface is user-friendly, and the viral sharing options help spread the word faster than I ever expected.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms setup is simple and viral sharing works as promised.

trials.claim: All future Free Tier 1 or Pro Tier 2 plan updates included
trials.claimQuote: All future Free (Tier 1) or Pro (Tier 2) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue the services at any time, materially limiting a guarantee of all future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: The Company reserves the right at any time to modify, suspend, or discontinue providing the Services, in whole or in part.
exhibits.argument: The quote lets the vendor modify or discontinue services, undermining guaranteed future updates.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to adjust pricing for our service or any components thereof in any manner and at any time as we may determine in our sole and absolute discretion.
exhibits.argument: The quote allows unilateral pricing changes, undermining a locked lifetime plan promise.

trials.claim: Run viral giveaways that drive email leads and grow audience
trials.claimQuote: KingSumo helps you run viral giveaways that drive more email leads, reward brand engagement, and grow your audience.
trials.reasoning: Reviewers report it rarely brings in more people than the original audience and drew under 5k contestants despite bigger prizes and audience, directly undercutting the audience-growth claim.

exhibits.quote: rarely ever does it actually bring in more people than your original audience but worth a shot I guess.
exhibits.argument: The quote reports the tool does not grow audience beyond the original audience.

exhibits.quote: we have had under 5k contestants, despite having bigger prizes and a bigger audience.
exhibits.argument: The quote reports fewer entrants despite bigger prizes and audience, contradicting lead growth.

exhibits.quote: Entrants share with friends for extra entries. Your audience grows on autopilot!
exhibits.argument: This vendor statement confirms viral sharing drives audience growth.

exhibits.quote: As a small business owner and author, running giveaways is one of the best ways I’ve found to grow my audience and connect with new readers, and KingSumo makes it incredibly easy.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms running giveaways with KingSumo grows audience.

trials.claim: Give away one grand prize or multiple smaller prizes
trials.claimQuote: Give away one grand prize or multiple smaller prizes
trials.reasoning: A reviewer reports there is no way to add different gifts, such as small gifts along the way and a big one at the end, conflicting with offering multiple smaller prizes.

exhibits.quote: No way to add different gifts (small gift´s on the way and a big one at the end)
exhibits.argument: The quote reports inability to add multiple different gifts as claimed.

exhibits.quote: we may void the prize if you don’t respond to emails in the required timeframe, live in an area where we’re unwilling or unable to ship the prize, or as otherwise deemed necessary by Sumo Group Inc.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows prizes can be voided at vendor discretion, limiting the prize promise.

trials.claim: Embed giveaways anywhere using widget code
trials.claimQuote: Embed giveaways anywhere using a simple widget code
trials.reasoning: Reviewers report no code was shared to integrate on their own website and the embedded version errors in Facebook's native browser, conflicting with embedding anywhere via widget code.

exhibits.quote: No way to integrate this on the own website (only iFrame, but no code shared)
exhibits.argument: The quote reports no way to integrate on own website with code as claimed.

exhibits.quote: But the embedded version of the giveaway doesn’t work in the Facebook native browser – it comes up with an error for contestants.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows the embed fails in Facebook browser, contradicting embed anywhere.
